## Requirements (from the contract)
- **R-2.12.3 (measurement)** — the Stage-0 spike as the acceptance check that measures what the ecosystem decision could not (C5/C7/C12); feeds GATE-G1 revalidation.
- **R-2.5.5 (S1 spike)** — one sandboxed tool call through a helper-binary boundary; fan-out/footprint (C5/C7); M-S1-1…9.
- **R-2.2.5 (S2 boundary slice)** — the S1 kernel driven over the boundary; C12; M-S2-1…7.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC-G (gating, §9.1 / §10.6):** S1 gates G1–G4 and measurements M-S1-1…9; S2 measurements M-S2-1…7 with **M-S2-6 pass** and **M-S2-7 at 100 %**; scored against the pre-registered bands in `research/synthesis/l1-spike-spec.md §5`; the measurement sheet appended to ADR-0050's amendment log; the revalidation rule evaluated (any C5/C7/C12 score outside assumed ±1, or a winning-candidate gate failure, re-runs ADR-0009 steps 5–7). Each measurement repeat-scored **N≥3**, reported as median + spread. No claim about any harness at Stage 0.
- **AC-U (universal phase-gate):** verification green; deterministic gates have tests that fail if removed; requirement ids stamped; anything unmeasurable-offline is a DEFERRALS row + compensating control; ADRs for every deviation/owned decision; BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER advanced.

## Plan
Throwaway spike code (R1–R6), outside the Cargo workspace (`exclude=["spikes"]`), reusing only the pure-std `hh-wire` primitives (canonical JSON, SHA-256, JSON-RPC framing) so everything runs offline/hermetic. Output is the measurement sheet; the code is committed-but-throwaway (deletable at the Stage-0 boundary; ADR extends ADR-0220's R4 deviation for reproducibility/CC3).

**Scope stance (offline/hermetic + CC9 matched-budget-or-refuse).** The winning candidate is **E5a = E1 kernel + E2 lab**. I measure the **E1 kernel** (S1) and the **crossing mechanism** (S2) — everything derivable offline. Foreign-ecosystem candidates (E2/E3 kernels for S1; E2 lab / E3 surface for the E5b/E5c splits) require foreign toolchains, network SDK fetches (MCP/ACP official SDKs) and cross-camp human reviewers (R2) — **not runnable offline/hermetic and not matchable-budget offline (CC9)** → DEFER with compensating controls, never fabricate. The revalidation rule turns on the **winning candidate**, which IS measured; the kernel-family robustness (ADR-0050 §4, 0.979 of corners) means the non-winning candidates are not decision-load-bearing.

- `spikes/s1-kernel-spike/` (new, throwaway) — append-only ledger (ADR-0027 id model: run_id/event_id, dense seq, parent_event_id, lease_generation; atomic multi-event append; durable-before-visible), idp/1-class canonical form + per-run hash chain (hh-wire), one `project()` view + rebuild-equality, 64 KiB blob offload, one sandboxed call **through a helper binary** (`s1-helper`), N=1/N=50 workload (200 events/session), cancellation, streaming tail. Gates G1–G4 as deterministic unit tests. Emits `key value` lines.
- `spikes/s2-boundary-spike/` (extend) — add M-S2-1 (split-vs-native, **matched E1↔E1**), M-S2-3 (canonical parse+hash-verify at 16/64 KiB), M-S2-6 (version-mismatch refusal + resume-after-killed-peer via a minimal throwaway session/resume), keep M-S2-2/4/7.
- `scripts/spike-s1-kernel.sh`, `scripts/spike-s0.3-measurement-sheet.sh` — run each spike **N≥3**, compute per-metric median + spread, write `docs/build/reports/S0.3-measurement-sheet.md`, and the amendment-log block appended to `research/decisions/ADR-0050.md`.

**Self-review (design, Pass 2).** Re-read every changed file from disk. Findings: (a) G3 simulates
the torn-WAL on-disk state directly rather than SIGKILL mid-fsync — a faithful model of the state a
crash leaves; noted in the test. (b) M-S1-2 RSS is process-wide/50 (conservative over-estimate of
per-session footprint) — favorable-direction bias, acceptable. (c) The honesty-critical calls
(`native_roundtrips` matched-ness, `build_chain_in_memory` CPU fan-out, cancel propagation) were
re-read and are matched/faithful. No red carried forward; no unresolved design concern.
